name: Tae
source: Tae will always act first and think later, if she contemplates her actions at all. She's a bundle of energy and will grow bored if she sits still for longer than a second. You don't want to cross her as she has a tendency of going all out when taking vengeance for an insult.
translation: Tae will always act first and think later, if she contemplates her actions at all. She's a bundle of energy and will grow bored if she sits still for longer than a second. You don't want to cross her as she has a tendency of going all out when taking vengeance for an insult.
